preset_description: 40 Hz gamma binaural beats for peak attention and cognitive binding. Research: MIT Tsai Lab (Nature 2016) demonstrated 40 Hz entrainment reduces amyloid plaques; Phase II clinical trials showed slowed brain atrophy in Alzheimer's patients; Rakhshan et al. (2022 RCT, n=31) confirmed gamma EEG induction and working memory improvement. This preset is optimized for short focus bursts (15 min). For longer neuroprotection sessions, increase duration and lower volume. WARNING: Risk of overstimulation with extended high-volume use. Stop if headaches or discomfort occur. NOT recommended for ADHD - try 10 Hz Alpha or 14 Hz SMR instead. REQUIRES HEADPHONES. Individual response varies significantly.
